name: collab
description: collab-plugin — autonomous multi-agent collaboration. Single /collab command; kickoff/join/tick/status/abort routing; JSONL events on git transport; cross-machine + cross-harness.

interface.longDescription: Single /collab <message> command orchestrates autonomous multi-agent collaborations on a structured event log over git. Cross-machine, cross-harness. Requires core-plugin.
